- Roasted chicken breast with skin, including loose meat and skin pieces.
- No visible sauce or oil beyond the drippings already on the skin.

**STEP 4 - Area:** The chicken piece measures about 15 × 7 cm (it lies diagonally). It covers about 17% of the plate, which is about 90 cm². Total food coverage is about 17%.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** The piece is thick, up to about 5 cm, and tapers toward the edges, so I use an average height of about 4 cm. 90 cm² × 4 cm ≈ 360 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Meat density is about 0.9 g/ml, but the loose shreds and possible bone lower the effective density. I estimate about 0.75 g/ml. 360 ml × 0.75 ≈ 270 g, of which about 250 g is edible meat and skin.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Roasted chicken breast with skin is about 197 kcal/100 g. 250 g × 1.97 ≈ 493 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A large rotisserie half-breast typically weighs about 200–300 g, so roughly 250 g and about 490 kcal is plausible.
